name: Iuchair

attributes.attribute: an Irish divinity, one of the sons of the goddess Danu, called the Sons of Tuireann
set impossible tasks with his brothers after the death of Cian

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Iuchair is an Irish divinity. He was one of the three sons of the goddess Danu. The three were called the sons of Tuireann. They were set a series of tasks that were nearly impossible. The tasks came after they killed the enemy Cian. Iuchair is also written Iuchar. Some accounts make Iuchair the father of Ecne, a being of wisdom. The brothers were so confused in the tales that some readers take them for one figure seen three times. Others link them to three Tuatha De Danann kings.
objective: Document Iuchair as an Irish divinity.
key_results: Record Iuchair as one of the Sons of Tuireann.
Note the reading of the brothers as one figure.
